rows.operation: GP in-hours weekly bulletins for 2026 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: GP consultation trends are anonymised population-surveillance signals; they cannot diagnose an individual or establish illness burden, service availability or safety at an exact address or parcel.

rows.operation: GP out-of-hours syndromic surveillance weekly bulletins for 2026 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Out-of-hours consultation trends are broad surveillance indicators and cannot identify diagnosis, urgency, capacity or risk for a person, household or exact parcel.

rows.operation: Remote health advice weekly bulletins for 2026 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: NHS 111 call trends are anonymised national surveillance signals and cannot establish diagnosis, emergency need or public-safety conditions at a specific address or parcel.

rows.operation: Syndromic surveillance weekly summaries for 2026 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Cross-system changes in GP, emergency-department and NHS 111 activity are population-level indicators; they cannot be converted into individual, hospital-catchment or exact-parcel risk scores.

rows.operation: HSE public register of enforcement notices exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Enforcement notices concern identified dutyholders, activities and legal breaches and are published after an appeal and quality-assurance delay; they do not establish general neighbourhood or parcel safety.

rows.operation: HSE enforcement notices London geographic search snapshot exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Filtered notice counts and first-page results are dynamic, delayed enforcement records; they must not be aggregated into a current borough, street or exact-parcel danger score.

rows.operation: Office for Nuclear Regulation annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Regulatory performance and national nuclear-safety oversight findings do not establish radiation, security or hazard conditions at a named site, property or exact parcel.

rows.operation: Office for Nuclear Regulation Corporate Plan 2026 to 2027 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Planned regulatory priorities and intended work are governance context, not observed safety performance or evidence of hazard at a nuclear site, address or parcel.

rows.operation: Nuclear Decommissioning Authority annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Group-level decommissioning, incident and environmental performance cannot be used as a direct measurement of safety, contamination or risk at a named site or exact parcel.
